display: DocSpring - Generate PDFs in a Batch

ABu.caption: Submissions (JSON)
ABu.doc: A JSON list with one object per PDF (up to 50), such as [{"data": {"name": "Jane"}, "metadata": {"user_id": 1}}]. Each object can also have field_overrides, test, template_id and template_version.
ABu.name: submissions

ABv.caption: Template ID
ABv.doc: The template for each submission that doesn't name its own template_id. Starts with 'tpl_'.
ABv.name: templateId

ABw.caption: Template Version
ABw.doc: Optional. A published version such as 1.2.0 (or 1 for the latest 1.x.x), latest, or draft. Default: the latest published version (the draft when none has been published).
ABw.name: version

ABx.caption: Test Mode
ABx.doc: Test PDFs are free, but they include watermarks. A test API token always makes test PDFs.
ABx.name: test

ABy.caption: Metadata
ABy.doc: Your own data about the record, such as an ID from your app. It isn't printed on the PDF, and it's sent with webhooks.
ABy.name: metadata

ABz.caption: Make Page Images
ABz.doc: Also make a PNG image of each page of the PDF (up to 100 pages).
ABz.name: makePageImages

ACA.caption: Wait
ACA.doc: Wait up to 45 seconds for every PDF. Turn it off to return straight away.
ACA.name: wait
